description.en: A searchable reference library of real mobile and web product screens, interface elements, and complete user flows.
description.zh: 收錄真實行動裝置與網站產品畫面、介面元素及完整使用流程的可搜尋參考庫。

bestFor.en: Studying how established products solve a specific screen or multi-step interaction.
bestFor.zh: 研究成熟產品如何處理特定畫面或多步驟互動。

description.en: A hand-picked shelf of beautifully designed macOS apps, with a quick visual browse of useful desktop products.
description.zh: 精選設計精美的 macOS 應用程式，讓你快速瀏覽實用的桌面產品與介面。

bestFor.en: Studying polished native macOS interface and interaction patterns when designing a desktop product.
bestFor.zh: 設計桌面產品時，研究完成度高的原生 macOS 介面與互動模式。

description.en: A curated archive of distinctive mobile websites and unconventional digital experiences, browsable by visual and interaction tags.
description.zh: 精選獨特行動網站與非典型數位體驗的資料庫，可依視覺與互動標籤瀏覽。

bestFor.en: Finding expressive mobile-web references when a standard responsive layout feels too predictable.
bestFor.zh: 當標準響應式版面過於制式時，尋找更具表現力的行動網頁參考。

description.en: A compact, opinionated feed of noteworthy live websites selected for daily web design inspiration.
description.zh: 精簡而有明確品味的優秀網站清單，持續提供每日網站設計靈感。

bestFor.en: Finding a fresh visual direction without wading through a large popularity-driven gallery.
bestFor.zh: 不必翻找受熱門度主導的大型圖庫，也能快速找到新鮮的視覺方向。

description.en: A broad curated feed spanning interfaces, websites, branding, typography, motion, editorial work, and digital products.
description.zh: 涵蓋介面、網站、品牌、字體、動態、編輯設計與數位產品的綜合精選目錄。

bestFor.en: Starting broad when you need references across more than one design discipline.
bestFor.zh: 需要跨越多種設計領域尋找參考時，先從廣泛的精選內容開始。

description.en: A large designer community and visual showcase covering interfaces, branding, illustration, animation, and portfolios.
description.zh: 大型設計師社群與視覺作品平台，涵蓋介面、品牌、插畫、動畫與作品集。

bestFor.en: Exploring many visual directions quickly or discovering designers with a particular style.
bestFor.zh: 快速探索大量視覺方向，或尋找具備特定風格的設計師。

description.en: An independently curated library of Webflow, Framer, and Shopify templates reviewed for both design and implementation quality.
description.zh: 獨立精選的 Webflow、Framer 與 Shopify 範本庫，同時檢視視覺設計與實作品質。

bestFor.en: Choosing a polished starting point without evaluating every template marketplace listing yourself.
bestFor.zh: 不必逐一檢查範本市集的所有項目，也能找到完成度高的起點。

description.en: A curated gallery of website footers organized across typographic, illustrative, grid, animated, and dark styles.
description.zh: 精選網站頁尾畫廊，依字體、插畫、網格、動畫與深色等風格整理。

bestFor.en: Studying how a page closes with navigation, utility links, and a final visual gesture.
bestFor.zh: 研究頁面如何以導覽、實用連結與最後的視覺收束完成頁尾。

description.en: A weekly gallery of exceptional websites filed by the exact detail each capture shows — hero, footer, button, navigation, page transition, scroll animation — with a vault of copyable snippets alongside.
description.zh: 每週更新的優秀網站畫廊，每則擷取都依其展示的細節歸類，如 hero、頁尾、按鈕、導覽、頁面轉場與捲動動畫，並附上可複製的程式碼片段。

bestFor.en: Comparing how many sites handle one specific element or interaction, instead of scanning whole pages for the part you need.
bestFor.zh: 針對單一元素或互動，橫向比較多個網站的做法，不必逐頁翻找所需的片段。

description.en: A juried showcase recognizing ambitious websites from designers, developers, studios, and agencies around the world.
description.zh: 由評審選出的網站作品平台，收錄全球設計師、開發者、工作室與代理商的前沿作品。

bestFor.en: Studying high-craft visual direction, interaction, and implementation in live production websites.
bestFor.zh: 研究正式上線網站中的高完成度視覺方向、互動與實作。

description.en: A curated reference wall for well-designed social posts, product announcements, launches, and visual updates.
description.zh: 精選社群貼文、產品公告、發布內容與視覺更新的設計參考牆。

bestFor.en: Planning a launch post or translating product news into a clear visual format.
bestFor.zh: 規劃產品發布貼文，或把產品消息轉化成清楚的視覺格式。

description.en: A curated collection of presentation decks and individual slides across pitches, reports, guidelines, portfolios, and strategy.
description.zh: 精選簡報與單頁投影片目錄，涵蓋提案、報告、品牌規範、作品集與策略。

bestFor.en: Finding structure and visual pacing for a specific kind of presentation.
bestFor.zh: 為特定類型的簡報尋找內容結構與視覺節奏。

description.en: A focused logo inspiration library organized by type, industry, style, shape, color, and mood.
description.zh: 依類型、產業、風格、形狀、色彩與氛圍整理的標誌設計靈感庫。

bestFor.en: Building a precise logo moodboard or comparing directions for a new identity.
bestFor.zh: 建立精準的標誌情緒板，或比較新品牌識別的可能方向。

description.en: A searchable library of free SVG logos for apps, developer tools, and technology brands, with quick copy and download workflows.
description.zh: 可搜尋的免費 SVG 標誌庫，收錄應用程式、開發工具與科技品牌，支援快速複製與下載。

bestFor.en: Finding a ready-to-use brand mark before drawing or exporting a logo asset yourself; check each brand's guidelines before use.
bestFor.zh: 在自行繪製或匯出標誌素材前，先尋找可直接使用的品牌標誌；使用前請確認各品牌的規範。

description.en: A showcase of real brand guideline documents linking to identity systems created in-house and by design studios.
description.zh: 收錄企業內部與設計工作室製作的真實品牌規範文件與識別系統。

bestFor.en: Seeing how a visual identity becomes practical rules, assets, and documentation.
bestFor.zh: 觀察視覺識別如何轉化為可執行的規則、素材與文件。

description.en: A Threads account posting free color palette cards, each swatch captioned with its name and hex code. The paid dictionary it promotes is optional.
description.zh: 以 Threads 帳號形式免費發布配色卡片，每個色塊都標註色名與 hex 色碼；其推廣的付費色彩字典並非必要。

bestFor.en: Grabbing a ready-made palette with usable hex values when a project needs a starting color direction.
bestFor.zh: 在專案需要初步配色方向時，直接取用附帶 hex 色碼的現成調色盤。

description.en: An independent archive documenting typefaces as they appear in real branding, editorial, packaging, software, and web projects.
description.zh: 記錄字體在真實品牌、編輯、包裝、軟體與網站專案中如何使用的獨立資料庫。

bestFor.en: Evaluating a typeface through finished work instead of an isolated specimen.
bestFor.zh: 透過完成作品而非單獨字體樣張，判斷字體的實際效果。

description.en: A visually led catalog of typefaces available under various free licenses, organized by broad typographic style.
description.zh: 以視覺瀏覽為主的字體目錄，收錄採用各類免費授權的字體，並依主要字體風格分類。

bestFor.en: Discovering distinctive type options before confirming the license on the original source.
bestFor.zh: 先探索具有特色的字體選項，再回到原始來源確認授權範圍。

description.en: A cross-system reference showing how real design systems name and implement common interface components.
description.zh: 整理真實設計系統如何命名與實作常見介面元件的跨系統參考庫。

bestFor.en: Comparing established patterns before designing or naming a component.
bestFor.zh: 在設計或命名元件前，比較業界已建立的實作模式。

description.en: A community marketplace for React and Tailwind components, templates, and themes from independent design engineers.
description.zh: 由獨立設計工程師共同建立的 React 與 Tailwind 元件、範本和主題市集。

bestFor.en: Browsing a broad catalog or bringing component ideas into AI-assisted workflows.
bestFor.zh: 瀏覽大量元件，或把元件靈感帶進 AI 輔助開發流程。

description.en: A collection of free Figma layout blocks recreated for close inspection, remixing, and hands-on design study.
description.zh: 可在 Figma 中仔細拆解、重新組合與動手研究的免費版面區塊集合。

bestFor.en: Learning layout decisions by taking polished interface sections apart pixel by pixel.
bestFor.zh: 逐像素拆解完成度高的介面區塊，理解背後的版面決策。

description.en: An endless spatial canvas of original animated web components that can be opened individually and copied into a project.
description.zh: 以無限空間畫布呈現原創網頁動畫元件，可逐一開啟查看並把程式碼複製到專案中。

bestFor.en: Exploring unconventional interaction ideas through a playful, highly visual browsing experience.
bestFor.zh: 透過具有玩心且高度視覺化的瀏覽方式，探索非典型的互動構想。

description.en: A community-built library of several thousand open-source UI elements, each copyable as plain HTML/CSS, Tailwind, React, or Figma.
description.zh: 由社群共同建立的開源介面元素庫，收錄數千個元件，每個都可複製為純 HTML/CSS、Tailwind、React 或 Figma 格式。

bestFor.en: Borrowing a visual treatment for a single element, then rebuilding it on accessible primitives — submissions are community-made and rarely keyboard- or screen-reader-ready.
bestFor.zh: 為單一元素借用視覺處理手法，再以無障礙基礎元件重新實作——社群投稿的元件通常未考量鍵盤操作與螢幕閱讀器。

description.en: A free, MIT-licensed library of 154 copy-paste React and Tailwind components across 26 categories, spanning buttons and widgets alongside device mockups and annotation callouts.
description.zh: 免費且採 MIT 授權的元件庫，收錄 154 個可複製貼上的 React 與 Tailwind 元件，分為 26 個類別，涵蓋按鈕、小工具，以及裝置外框與註解標示等元件。

bestFor.en: Taking a consistently styled component as source you own — including presentation pieces like device frames and callouts — with no dependency and no attribution required.
bestFor.zh: 取得風格一致且由自己掌握的元件原始碼，包含裝置外框與註解標示等簡報用元件，不需引入相依套件，也無須標註出處。

description.en: Accessible, customizable component source code that becomes part of your own React codebase.
description.zh: 可客製、具備無障礙基礎，並直接成為 React 專案原始碼的元件集合。

bestFor.en: Starting a product design system while keeping full ownership of the implementation.
bestFor.zh: 建立產品設計系統，同時保有完整的實作掌控權。

description.en: Adobe's unstyled React components and hooks for robust keyboard, touch, and assistive-technology behavior.
description.zh: Adobe 提供的無樣式 React 元件與 hooks，處理鍵盤、觸控及輔助科技互動。

bestFor.en: Complex widgets where accessibility and interaction behavior cannot be improvised.
bestFor.zh: 無障礙與互動行為不能靠臨場拼湊的複雜元件。

description.en: A catalog of polished motion patterns and animated components aimed at real product flows.
description.zh: 聚焦真實產品流程的精緻動態模式與動畫元件目錄。

bestFor.en: Dashboards, uploads, tables, navigation, and other in-product interactions.
bestFor.zh: 儀表板、上傳、表格、導覽及其他產品內互動。

description.en: A visually dramatic collection of animated React components, backgrounds, and landing-page sections.
description.zh: 視覺張力鮮明的 React 動畫元件、背景效果與登陸頁區塊集合。

bestFor.en: High-impact marketing pages that need expressive motion quickly.
bestFor.zh: 需要快速加入強烈動態效果的高衝擊力行銷頁面。

description.en: Animated components and effects designed to layer cleanly onto a shadcn-style foundation.
description.zh: 能自然疊加在 shadcn 風格基礎上的動畫元件與視覺效果。

bestFor.en: Adding restrained polish to product marketing and portfolio surfaces.
bestFor.zh: 替產品行銷頁與作品集加入節制而精緻的動態質感。

description.en: A browsable collection of animated backgrounds, text treatments, effects, and interactive React components.
description.zh: 可瀏覽的 React 動畫背景、文字效果、視覺特效與互動元件集合。

bestFor.en: Finding a specific visual effect without building its animation from scratch.
bestFor.zh: 尋找特定視覺效果，不必從零開始製作動畫。

description.en: A focused library of spring-physics interface animations with live tuning and copyable implementations.
description.zh: 專注彈簧物理介面動畫的工具庫，提供即時調校與可複製實作。

bestFor.en: Learning and tuning motion that should feel physical rather than decorative.
bestFor.zh: 學習與調整具有物理感、而非純裝飾性的動態效果。

description.en: A copyable collection of animated React and Tailwind components, effects, and larger page blocks for expressive interfaces.
description.zh: 可複製使用的 React 與 Tailwind 動畫元件、視覺效果及大型頁面區塊集合。

bestFor.en: Adding animated product or landing-page sections while retaining access to the implementation.
bestFor.zh: 為產品或登陸頁加入動畫區塊，同時保留對實作程式碼的掌控。

description.en: A library of 66 animated text effects built in pure CSS, each self-contained and offered alongside a ready-made prompt for coding agents.
description.zh: 收錄 66 種純 CSS 文字動畫效果的工具庫，每個效果皆可獨立使用，並附上可直接交給編碼代理的提示詞。

bestFor.en: Adding a single expressive headline or wordmark animation without pulling in a JavaScript motion dependency.
bestFor.zh: 在不引入 JavaScript 動畫套件的前提下，為單一標題或字標加上具表現力的動態效果。

description.en: An open-source React library of 42 animated loading indicators split across text, inline, and image variants, each with an adjustable animation speed.
description.zh: 開源的 React 動態載入指示器套件，收錄 42 種文字、行內與圖片三類變體，每一種都可調整動畫速度。

bestFor.en: Filling the wait in AI-generated interfaces, where streaming responses need a loading state that matches the content being produced.
bestFor.zh: 為 AI 生成介面填補等待時間，讓串流輸出搭配符合該內容型態的載入狀態。

description.en: A collaborative, hand-drawn-style canvas for turning flows, systems, and early ideas into diagrams quickly.
description.zh: 具手繪風格的協作畫布，能快速把流程、系統關係與早期想法整理成圖解。

bestFor.en: Explaining a complex idea before its structure is stable enough for formal design documentation.
bestFor.zh: 在結構尚未穩定到能寫成正式設計文件前，先把複雜想法說清楚。

description.en: A large handcrafted SVG icon catalog with outline and filled styles across multiple frameworks.
description.zh: 大型手工 SVG 圖示目錄，提供線框、填滿風格與多框架支援。

bestFor.en: Searching a consistent icon family before reaching for one-off assets.
bestFor.zh: 在尋找零散素材前，先從一致的圖示家族中挑選。

description.en: A browser-based tool for turning compatible SVG icons into adjustable stroke-draw animations.
description.zh: 把相容 SVG 圖示轉成可調整描邊動畫的瀏覽器工具。

bestFor.en: Quick icon micro-interactions without setting up a motion project.
bestFor.zh: 不必建立完整動畫專案，就能快速製作圖示微互動。

description.en: A living, practical checklist for the interaction, typography, motion, touch, performance, accessibility, and design details that make web interfaces feel considered.
description.zh: 持續更新的實用清單，整理讓網站介面更完整的互動、字體、動態、觸控、效能、無障礙與設計細節。

bestFor.en: Auditing the details of a web interface before polishing a release.
bestFor.zh: 在打磨版本前，逐項檢查網站介面的細節。

description.en: A small, dependency-free, fully themeable fluid stepper component with click navigation and optional autoplay.
description.zh: 小巧、無相依且可完整主題化的流動式 stepper 元件，支援點擊導覽與選用的自動播放。

bestFor.en: Adding a polished, stateful stepper without assembling the interaction from scratch.
bestFor.zh: 不必從零組合互動，就能加入完成度高且具狀態的 stepper。

description.en: A focused drawer component for React, presented with documentation and an interactive example.
description.zh: 專注於抽屜互動的 React 元件，提供文件與可操作的示範。

bestFor.en: Studying a polished React drawer interaction before building a similar pattern yourself.
bestFor.zh: 在自行建立類似模式前，研究完成度高的 React 抽屜互動。

description.en: Linear's guide to managing design projects, from verifying the problem and exploring options to feedback, direction, and design–engineering handoff.
description.zh: Linear 的設計專案管理方法，從確認問題、探索方案，到回饋、定案與設計工程交接。

bestFor.en: Structuring collaborative design work when requirements and solutions are still evolving.
bestFor.zh: 在需求與解法仍持續變動時，建立協作設計工作的結構。

description.en: A practical essay on developing design taste by studying strong work, naming why it works, and practicing deliberately.
description.zh: 透過研究優秀作品、說清楚它為何有效並刻意練習，培養設計品味的實用文章。

bestFor.en: Building a repeatable critique habit instead of relying on instinct alone.
bestFor.zh: 建立可重複的設計評析習慣，而不只依賴直覺。

description.en: An open-source design language for AI coding agents, pairing a design skill and commands with a deterministic detector for common AI design anti-patterns.
description.zh: 為 AI coding agent 打造的開源設計語言，結合設計技能與指令，並以規則式偵測器找出常見的 AI 設計壞習慣。

bestFor.en: Raising the design quality of agent-generated interfaces without reviewing every screen by hand.
bestFor.zh: 不必逐一手動檢視每個畫面，就能提升 agent 產生介面的設計品質。

description.en: A React dev-mode overlay for annotating interface elements in the browser, exporting each note with its CSS selector, position, and context as Markdown.
description.zh: 在瀏覽器中標注介面元素的 React 開發模式覆蓋層，可將每則註記連同 CSS 選擇器、位置與脈絡匯出成 Markdown。

bestFor.en: Pointing a coding agent at the exact element you want changed instead of describing it in prose.
bestFor.zh: 與其用文字描述，不如直接把 coding agent 指向你想修改的那個元素。

description.en: An open-source framework that generates skeleton loading screens from real components at build time, capturing each layout across breakpoints for React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and React Native.
description.zh: 開源框架，在建置階段直接從真實元件產生骨架載入畫面，並跨斷點擷取各自的版面，支援 React、Vue、Svelte、Angular 與 React Native。

bestFor.en: Replacing hand-measured placeholder screens with generated ones — a production dependency with a build step, not a snippet to copy.
bestFor.zh: 以自動產生的骨架取代手工測量的載入佔位畫面；這是需要建置步驟的正式相依套件，而非可直接複製的片段。

description.en: A categorized directory of tools for web-focused design engineers, spanning inspiration, AI coding, components, motion, 3D, utilities, and more.
description.zh: 為網站設計工程師整理的分類工具目錄，涵蓋靈感、AI 程式開發、元件、動態、3D、實用工具等領域。

bestFor.en: Scanning the broader design-engineering landscape when you know the task or medium but not which tool to use.
bestFor.zh: 已知要處理的工作或媒介，卻還不確定該用哪項工具時，用來快速瀏覽更完整的設計工程工具版圖。

description.en: A library of design systems extracted from real product websites and published as DESIGN.md files that coding agents can read directly.
description.zh: 從真實產品網站萃取設計系統，並整理成程式開發代理可直接讀取的 DESIGN.md 檔案庫。

bestFor.en: Handing an AI coding assistant a concrete visual reference so generated UI follows a chosen system instead of defaulting to a generic look.
bestFor.zh: 把具體的視覺參考交給 AI 程式助理，讓產出的介面依循選定的設計系統，而不是落入千篇一律的預設樣貌。

description.en: A searchable library of UI patterns spanning navigation, layout, forms, feedback, commerce, mobile, and other product interface needs.
description.zh: 可搜尋的 UI 模式資料庫，涵蓋導覽、版面、表單、回饋、商務、行動介面與其他產品介面需求。

bestFor.en: Naming and comparing common interface patterns when designing a product screen or explaining UI to an AI coding assistant.
bestFor.zh: 設計產品畫面，或向 AI 程式助理說明介面時，用來辨識與比較常見的介面模式。

description.en: A visual glossary of web UI parts, styles, interactions, and CSS fundamentals for describing interfaces clearly to AI coding assistants.
description.zh: 以視覺化方式整理網站 UI 元件、樣式、互動與 CSS 基礎，幫助更清楚地向 AI 程式助理描述介面。

bestFor.en: Learning the vocabulary needed to turn a vague interface idea into a precise prompt for an AI-built website.
bestFor.zh: 學習把模糊的介面想法轉成精準 AI 網站製作提示所需的詞彙。

description.en: The personal site of a product designer and engineer, re-themed live from a panel of font, colour, radius, and background controls, alongside released motion components such as Transitions.dev, Border Beam, and Liquid Metal.
description.zh: 產品設計師兼工程師的個人網站，可透過字體、顏色、圓角與背景控制面板即時改變頁面樣式，並展示 Transitions.dev、Border Beam、Liquid Metal 等已發布的動態元件。

bestFor.en: Studying how a design engineer makes a portfolio demonstrate its own craft instead of describing it, and lifting the motion components it ships.
bestFor.zh: 研究設計工程師如何讓作品集直接展現工藝本身而非只是描述，並取用其中發布的動態元件。

description.en: A multi-phase coding-agent skill for recon, vulnerability hunting, adversarial validation, structured findings, and independent verification.
description.zh: 支援偵察、漏洞搜尋、對抗式驗證、結構化發現與獨立複核的多階段 coding agent 安全稽核技能。

bestFor.en: Studying how to turn a coding agent into a disciplined security-audit workflow for authorized codebases.
bestFor.zh: 研究如何把 coding agent 轉化為有紀律的安全稽核流程，並只用於獲得授權的程式碼。

description.en: An open-source agentic SAST pipeline covering threat modeling, multi-lens analysis, adversarial verification, remediation, and fix validation.
description.zh: 涵蓋威脅建模、多視角分析、對抗式驗證、修補與修補驗證的開源 agentic SAST 流程。

bestFor.en: Understanding an end-to-end vulnerability workflow; scan only authorized repositories, and review every generated finding or fix before adoption.
bestFor.zh: 理解端到端漏洞處理流程；只掃描獲得授權的儲存庫，並在採用前人工檢視所有產生的發現與修補。

description.en: An autonomous, white-box AI pentester for web applications and APIs that combines source analysis with live exploitation to validate exploitable vulnerabilities.
description.zh: 以白箱方式分析網站應用程式與 API 原始碼，並透過實際利用驗證漏洞的自主 AI 滲透測試工具。

bestFor.en: Studying proof-by-exploitation workflows; run only against sandboxed systems you own or have explicit written authorization to test.
bestFor.zh: 研究以可重現利用證明漏洞的測試流程；只在沙盒或明確獲得書面授權的系統上執行。

description.en: A Snyk scanner that inventories AI agents, MCP servers, and agent skills, checking for prompt injection and other agent supply-chain threats.
description.zh: Snyk 的安全掃描器，可盤點 AI agents、MCP servers 與 agent skills，檢查提示注入及其他供應鏈風險。

bestFor.en: Auditing local agent components before use; scan untrusted MCP configurations inside a sandbox and review commands before consent.
bestFor.zh: 在採用前稽核本機上的 agent 元件；對不受信任的 MCP 設定檔先在沙盒中掃描，並在同意執行前檢查指令。

description.en: OpenAI's Apache-2.0 CLI and TypeScript SDK that scans a codebase for vulnerabilities, compares findings across scans, and proposes fixes.
description.zh: OpenAI 以 Apache-2.0 授權釋出的 CLI 與 TypeScript SDK，可掃描程式碼庫的漏洞、比較多次掃描的差異並提出修補建議。

bestFor.en: Wiring model-driven scans into a DevSecOps loop and tracking regressions between runs; scan only repositories you are authorized to test, and review every finding and fix before acting on it.
bestFor.zh: 把模型驅動的掃描接進 DevSecOps 流程並追蹤兩次執行之間的回歸；只掃描獲得授權的儲存庫，並在採用前人工檢視所有發現與修補。
